You are checking whether a test suite covers ONE specific requirement.

This is a mock3 project. The codebase uses vitest for testing and TypeScript for type safety. Test files use vitest's describe/it/expect APIs. When evaluating coverage, remember that:
- A test whose name or title suggests it covers the requirement is irrelevant if its assertions do not actually exercise it
- Boundary conditions (exact values, loop bounds, array indices) are easy to miss: a test named correctly but checking only approximate or adjacent values does not cover the actual boundary
- Requirements that specify something must NOT happen are not covered by tests that verify something DOES happen, even if the wording overlaps
